notes.title: Folian Beta 9
items: Existing projects now appear first when Folian opens.
The most recently used project is highlighted under Continue writing.
Other projects appear in a clearer Recent projects section.
New-project setup stays collapsed until you choose to create another project.
About Folian now provides a clearer Beta 9 version reference.

notes.title: Folian beta 8
items: Adds a native Check for Updates command to the Folian application menu.
Reports the installed release as up to date without downloading the same version again.
Makes update checking, availability, download and failure states clearer.
Refines AI model choices into recommended, advanced and older supported groups.
Adds independent local and GitHub download verification for release artifacts.

notes.title: Folian paid beta release candidate
items: Uses config.folian.app for desktop update discovery and the remote AI model catalogue.
Adds verified current and older supported AI model choices.
Keeps the stable desktop channel inactive until a real stable release is promoted.
Protects partial project setting updates from clearing omitted fields.
Preserves local projects, encrypted API keys, exports and backups during application updates.

notes.title: Folian beta foundation
items: Structured project setup, manuscript editing, research and export workflows.
